summary: Iteration 4 full-stack validation of ARIS-9 (server started via `cd /app && python3 server.py`, tested at http://localhost:8000 as Nyx). BACKEND: created /app/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 16 tests, 16/16 PASS) covering auth (login ok/invalid/status), auth-guard on both voice endpoints (401 without cookie), POST /api/voice/tts (200, Content-Type audio/mpeg, 19968 bytes real OpenAI audio via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; empty text -> 400; invalid JSON -> 400; invalid voice -> readable 500 'Invalid voice: ... Must be one of [...]'), POST /api/voice/stt (empty body -> 400 'Áudio ausente...'; garbage audio -> readable 500 from whisper-1, no traceback/HTML), plus regression on /api/system/info|cpu|disk, /api/tools and static delivery of the 3 new JS files. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, 4 Playwright runs, zero console/page errors): all 19 new globals present with correct types (aris9Prefs/Voice/Metrics/Undo/Profile/Schedules/Trace objects, openVoiceChat/closeVoiceChat/aris9ToolInstall/aris9ExplainError/aris9DailySummary/aris9IsWriteTool/aris9DetectRepeat/aris9ShouldNotify/agentAgain/agentAbort/__onAgentConfirm/__onAgentRepeatDetected functions). Drawer: drawer-btn-voice/metrics/daily + all 7 mode checkboxes + persona-select with exactly [minimal,padrao,detalhado,brincalhao] present and visible. Modes persist across ESC/reopen and set aris9Prefs correctly; badge-dryrun ('DRY-RUN') and badge-readonly ('READ-ONLY') are created/removed correctly in the DOM. Persona 'brincalhao' persists in localStorage aris9_agent_prefs and survives reload (select re-hydrated). MODO VOZ overlay opens with class .open, role=dialog, aria-modal=true, 96x96 mic button, 9 TTS voices in the documented order, 'Interromper voz' and ✕ close (closes correctly). JS APIs verified: aris9Undo.push/list/peek, aris9Metrics.get keys + logTool('foo') -> byTool.foo===1, aris9Schedules.add/all/remove(true), aris9Profile.get keys + bump increments interactions by 1, aris9ExplainError('ENOENT') -> humanized pt-BR message. Terminal commands .metrics, .persona detalhado, .mode dryrun on/off, .trace, .schedule list, .undo, .undo-list all produce the expected output AND stay in sync with drawer checkboxes/select. Confirm modal via window.__onAgentConfirm renders action-confirm/confirm-yes/confirm-no and confirm-no resolves the Promise to false and removes the overlay. Regression OK: hamburger aria-expanded toggle, focus moves into drawer, ESC closes and restores focus to mobile-menu-btn, terminal-input bottom 711px < taskbar top 759px, showNotification creates toast-info. Browser-side fetch of /api/voice/tts returned 200 audio/mpeg 19968 bytes and aris9Voice.speak() resolved without error. ONE real defect found: the status badges are painted UNDER the titlebar and are therefore invisible to the user.

minor.issue: Invalid `voice` value returns 500 ('Falha na síntese: Validation error: Invalid voice: ...') instead of 400. Message is readable and no crash, but a client-side input error should be 4xx. Consider validating voice/model against the allowed list before calling the provider.

_send_error returns text/plain bodies, but js/auth.js does `payload.error` after response.json() — so any auth failure shows the generic 'HTTP 401' instead of the server message 'Credenciais inválidas.'. Either return JSON errors or read res.text() in the frontend.

ui_bugs.issue: Badges exist in the DOM and report inViewport=true (top:4px, centered) but are rendered BEHIND #titlebar: document.elementFromPoint at each badge center returns #titlebar-title, and the badges are not visible in the 390x844 screenshot. RCA: #status-badges has z-index:500 while #titlebar (position:fixed, top:0, height:28px) has z-index:1000. Fix: move #status-badges inside the titlebar flex row, or set its z-index above 1000, or shift it below 28px.

issues: .help does not document any of the 8 new commands (.metrics, .persona, .trace, .schedule, .voice, .install, .again, .undo/.undo-list); only .mode appears. Users cannot discover the new iteration-4 commands.

design_issues.screen: Mobile 390x844 titlebar / terminal hints (carry-over from iteration 3)
issues: #titlebar-title remains very low contrast and truncated
terminal intro/help hint lines are dim teal on near-black and clip horizontally

action_items: Fix z-index/stacking so READ-ONLY and DRY-RUN badges are actually visible (currently hidden under #titlebar, z-index 500 vs 1000).
Add the new commands to .help output (.metrics, .persona, .trace, .schedule, .voice, .install, .again, .undo).
Return 400 (not 500) for invalid `voice`/`model` in /api/voice/tts by validating against the allowed voice list first.
Make error responses JSON (or parse text in js/auth.js) so login errors show 'Credenciais inválidas.' instead of 'HTTP 401'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1174 lines with all handlers in a single BaseHTTPRequestHandler class — split voice/system/browser handlers into modules.
js/terminal.js is 1367 lines — the new command handlers should be extracted into a command registry module.

asyncio.run() inside a synchronous ThreadingHTTPServer handler creates a fresh event loop and a new OpenAI client per request; TTS/STT calls block the worker thread for seconds. Acceptable for a local single-user app, but consider a shared loop/client if latency matters.
/api/voice/tts has no per-session rate limit or text-length quota beyond 4096 chars; with a shared session cookie any tab can burn LLM credits.
aris9Prefs.set(key, value) takes two positional args; several docs/tests assume set({obj}) — an object form silently returns false. Consider accepting a partial object.
seed_data_creation: No persistent server-side data. localStorage was cleared and transient test entries (undo entry 'teste', schedule 09:00/trab which was removed, metrics byTool.foo, profile bump) were written in the browser only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server is NOT supervisor-managed: start with `cd /app && python3 server.py &` (port 8000) before any test; there is no /app/frontend/.env. Login: the auth overlay is a plain #auth-form (#auth-username/#auth-password + submit) with no data-testids — wait with page.wait_for_function on document.getElementById('auth-overlay').hidden===true (the element is hidden, so wait_for_selector('[hidden]') times out). Backend suite lives at /app/tests/backend_test.py (16 tests, all pass, real OpenAI TTS call takes ~2s). Error bodies from this server are text/plain, not JSON. Remaining known-open items: badge z-index, .help missing new commands, TTS invalid-voice 500. Real MediaRecorder STT was intentionally not exercised.
rca_of_the_issue: Status badges invisible: #status-badges is position:fixed top:4px with z-index:500, while #titlebar is position:fixed top:0 height:28px with z-index:1000 — the titlebar paints over the badges. Verified via document.elementFromPoint at both badge centers returning #titlebar-title and via a clipped screenshot of the top 60px showing no badge. All badge state logic (create on pref change, remove on uncheck, drawer<->terminal sync via aris9:pref-changed) works correctly.
